audience.text: Python developers who need to parse OneNote documents programmatically for data extraction, document analysis, or PDF conversion in server-side or desktop applications.

capabilities.text: Load .one files from a path or binary stream using Document, supporting OneNote 2010 format and reporting FileFormat.OneNote2010.
capabilities.title: Parse OneNote documents from file or stream

capabilities.text: Use GetChildNodes or DocumentVisitor to recursively walk Page, Outline, OutlineElement, RichText, Image, Table, and AttachedFile nodes.
capabilities.title: Traverse document tree and extract content

capabilities.text: Access TextRuns and TextStyle to read bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, font, color, and hyperlinks.
capabilities.title: Extract rich text with per-run formatting

capabilities.text: Export to PDF using Document.Save with SaveFormat.Pdf and PdfSaveOptions for JPEG quality and image compression control.
capabilities.title: Export pages to PDF with options

capabilities.text: Access Image.Bytes and AttachedFile.Bytes with FileName to save embedded media and attachments to disk.
capabilities.title: Extract images and attached files

capabilities.text: Traverse Table, TableRow, TableCell, NoteTag, and NumberList to extract structured content and metadata.
capabilities.title: Inspect tables, tags, and numbered lists

capabilities.text: Access PageHistory via Document.GetPageHistory() and inspect page metadata like Author, CreationTime, and LastModifiedTime.
capabilities.title: Support for page history and revision metadata

limitations.text: Writing back to .one files is not implemented; this library only reads OneNote files.
Password-protected documents are not supported; supplying a password raises IncorrectPasswordException.
SaveFormat currently declares only Pdf; Document.Save raises UnsupportedSaveFormatException for other formats.
License.SetLicense and Metered.SetMeteredKey are no-ops in this edition and not required for use.
DetectLayoutChanges is a compatibility stub and performs no layout computation.
PDF export requires optional dependencies (reportlab, pypdf, Pillow, PyMuPDF) only for testing and output generation.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic access to OneNote content—including pages, rich text, images, tables, attachments, tags, and numbered lists—without requiring Microsoft OneNote to be installed.
Supports exporting OneNote pages to PDF with configurable image compression and JPEG quality, using optional dependencies like reportlab.
Provides a tree-based DOM traversal API via DocumentVisitor and GetChildNodes for inspecting and extracting structured content from OneNote documents.
Allows extraction of embedded images and attached files as raw bytes, with filenames and metadata, for archival or further processing.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Note FOSS for Python is a free, open-source Python library for reading Microsoft OneNote (.one) files and exporting pages to PDF, with no dependency on Microsoft OneNote or COM automation.

uncertainties: The exact set of OneNote file versions beyond OneNote2010 that are supported is not explicitly stated beyond FileFormat reporting.
Whether DocumentVisitor supports VisitTitleStart/End and VisitDocumentEnd is implied but not confirmed by public_symbol entries.
The behavior of Document.Clone and Page.Clone when cloneHistory=True is not detailed beyond method signatures.
The meaning and usage of LoadOptions.LoadHistory is not explained beyond its presence.
The scope of aspose.note._internal as implementation detail is stated but not verified by public_symbol entries.
The exact behavior of SaveOptions.PageSettings and PageSplittingAlgorithm is not described beyond their presence in PdfSaveOptions.
Whether AsposeNoteError is a public base class or internal is not confirmed by public_symbol entries.
The exact set of supported font names and color formats in TextStyle is not specified.

workflows.name: Load and inspect document metadata
workflows.text: Load a .one file using Document, then access DisplayName, CreationTime, and page count via iteration or len(list(doc)).

workflows.name: Extract rich text with formatting
workflows.text: Traverse RichText nodes, iterate TextRuns, and inspect TextStyle properties such as bold, italic, hyperlinks, font, and color.

workflows.name: Export document to PDF
workflows.text: Call Document.Save with SaveFormat.Pdf and optional PdfSaveOptions to tune JPEG quality and image compression.

workflows.name: Traverse tables and extract cell content
workflows.text: Iterate Table nodes, then TableRow and TableCell, joining RichText content to reconstruct tabular data.

workflows.name: Extract embedded images to disk
workflows.text: Iterate Image nodes, access Bytes and FileName, and write bytes to disk using pathlib.

workflows.name: Inspect OneNote tags and numbered lists
workflows.text: Access Tags on RichText or other nodes, and inspect NumberList properties on OutlineElement nodes.
